senses.example: El fin de semana vamos al pueblo.
senses.exampleGloss: At the weekend we go to the village.

alternatives.reason: Peninsular colloquial shortening; extremely common in fast speech.
A weekend extended by a holiday; not an ordinary weekend.
The whole week; the pair is easy to confuse for a beginner.

notes: Masculine noun phrase: el fin de semana; plural los fines de semana. Going to el pueblo at weekends is a real Navarre habit.
